mapper.select: SELECT user_idx, member_grade, cash_balance, mileage_balance, point_balance, level_no, exp_points FROM USERS WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} FOR UPDATE

SELECT point_reward_policy_idx AS policy_idx, reward_code, policy_name, reward_type, reward_value, unit_amount, is_active, description, priority FROM POINT_REWARD_POLICY WHERE reward_code = #{rewardCode} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, point_reward_policy_idx ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT exp_reward_policy_idx AS policy_idx, reward_code, policy_name, reward_type, reward_value, unit_amount, is_active, description, priority FROM EXP_REWARD_POLICY WHERE reward_code = #{rewardCode} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, exp_reward_policy_idx ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET cash_balance = #{cashBalance}, mileage_balance = #{mileageBalance}, point_balance = #{pointBalance}, exp_points = #{expPoints}, level_no = #{levelNo} WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_POINT_HISTORY ( user_idx, change_type, source_type, source_id, amount, balance_after, detail_message, actor_user_idx, related_purchase_idx, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{changeType}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{detailMessage}, #{actorUserIdx}, #{relatedPurchaseIdx}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT exp_level_policy_idx, policy_name, policy_mode, quadratic_a, quadratic_b, quadratic_c, exp_base, exp_rate, hybrid_switch_level, is_active, description, priority FROM EXP_LEVEL_POLICY WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY priority ASC, exp_level_policy_idx ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT exp_level_override_idx, level_no, required_total_exp, is_active, priority FROM EXP_LEVEL_OVERRIDE WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY level_no ASC, priority ASC, exp_level_override_idx ASC

SELECT level_up_reward_policy_idx, reward_code, policy_name, level_no, reward_type, reward_amount, item_code, is_repeatable, is_active, sort_order, description, priority FROM LEVEL_UP_REWARD_POLICY WHERE is_active = 1 AND level_no > #{fromLevelExclusive} AND level_no <= #{toLevelInclusive} ORDER BY level_no ASC, sort_order ASC, priority ASC, level_up_reward_policy_idx ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_LEVEL_UP_REWARD_HISTORY ( user_idx, level_up_reward_policy_idx, level_no, reward_type, reward_amount, item_code, point_inventory_idx, grant_status, granted_at, granted_by_user_idx, note, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{levelUpRewardPolicyIdx}, #{levelNo}, #{rewardType}, #{rewardAmount}, #{itemCode}, #{pointInventoryIdx}, #{grantStatus}, NOW(), #{grantedByUserIdx}, #{note}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO USER_POINT_ITEM_INVENTORY ( user_idx, item_code, quantity, is_active, acquired_at, last_used_at, related_purchase_idx, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{itemCode}, 1, 1, NOW(), NULL, NULL, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + 1, is_active = 1, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO USER_WALLET_HISTORY ( user_idx, asset_type, change_type, amount, balance_after, related_payment_idx, detail_message, actor_user_idx, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{assetType}, #{changeType}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{relatedPaymentIdx}, #{detailMessage}, #{actorUserIdx}, NOW() )
